how-26-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the machine, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-26-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the machine, then tap 3 things you notice.

how-26-02-compare.page: Put the ruler under one tray and the balance under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-26-02-compare.say: Put the ruler under one tray and the balance under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-26-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-26-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-26-02-det.page: Pick 3 files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the property being measured. Predict the tool, and watch it at work.
how-26-02-det.say: Pick three files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the property being measured. Predict the tool, and watch it at work.

how-26-02-partc.page: Draw a bar graph of the four hatchling masses from Part A. Label the bottom with A, B, C, and D, and the side with grams. Give your graph a title.
how-26-02-partc.say: Draw a bar graph of the four hatchling masses from Part A. Label the bottom with A, B, C, and D, and the side with grams. Give your graph a title.
